title: Decision: a call I-D, not a PR to mimi-content; issue first, then the #40 PR
description:
Mark asked 2026-11-23 whether to PR the MIMI I-D or write one.

DECIDED: write an I-D for call keying, and do not PR mimi-content for
it. Order: the mimi-content issue first, then the room-policy#40 PR,
then the I-D.

WHY NOT A PR TO MIMI-CONTENT:
1. It would be declined on scope rather than merit. §5.10 says "Further
   discussion of calling and conferencing functionality is out-of-scope
   of this document", so a PR adding call keying contradicts the
   document's own stated boundary and the editor need not weigh it.
2. The subject spans four documents: the session part in mimi-content,
   the exporter and Safe HPKE in mls-extensions (a different working
   group), the call room in mimi-room-policy, and a component id needing
   mimi-protocol's registry and an IANA action. No single PR carries
   that.
3. We have the precedent and it worked.
   draft-atwood-mimi-provider-auth is the same move -- a cross-cutting
   mechanism the WG drafts did not cover, written as its own I-D, with a
   "Replacement Text for the MIMI Protocol" section carrying the patch
   it wants in protocol §4.1. Jason engaged with it and an
   Implementation Status section is planned (bead mimid-75nk.10). The
   call I-D should take the same shape: its own document, with a
   replacement-text section for mimi-content §5.10.

THE ORDER, and why each step earns its place:

1. POST THE MIMI-CONTENT ISSUE (bead mimid-1wgh.37.106). It is nearly
   free and it is the cheapest available signal on whether the WG wants
   calling in scope at all. Writing a full I-D first risks weeks spent
   on something the WG declines on scope, which is the same objection as
   the PR, only more expensive.
2. PR ROOM-POLICY #40, and this one happens regardless of the answer.
   Strict subset to subset is a one-line fix, already filed as our own
   issue, squarely in scope for that document, and it blocks the
   call-room shape the keying analysis on mimid-96tt concludes we need.
   Cheap, correct, and useful even if calls never go further.
3. WRITE THE I-D once the appetite is known, or anyway if mimid needs
   keyed calls for its own sake.

Nothing is posted. Each upstream action still needs Mark's own per-action
OK, per AGENTS.md and the peer-contributing rules.
